query: Grandview Mall, 228 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: One of Guangzhou's largest malls, on Tianhe Road next to Tiyu Xilu metro.
summary.zh: 广州最大的商场之一，在天河路，紧邻体育西路地铁站。

why.en: Shopping, food and kids' attractions are combined under one roof, so a tired family can stay indoors for hours. An aquarium and other family attractions are inside, and the food floors cover most Cantonese and international options.
why.zh: 购物、吃饭和亲子玩乐都在一栋楼里，累了也不用出门。商场内有海洋馆等亲子项目，美食层粤菜和各国菜都有。

en: Direct link to Tiyu Xilu metro
zh: 商场内有海洋馆等亲子项目

tips.en: Attraction lineup changes; check the mall directory on arrival.
tips.zh: 商场内的亲子项目会更换，到时以商场导览为准。

query: Tianhe Sports Center, 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Stadium complex built for the 1987 National Games, with open lawns and paths in central Tianhe.
summary.zh: 为1987年全运会建的体育场馆群，天河中心难得的大片草地和步道。

why.en: Open green space is rare in the middle of Tianhe's malls, and kids can run freely here. Locals jog, play ball and walk dogs, so it gives a feel for everyday Guangzhou.
why.zh: 天河商圈中间少有的开阔空地，孩子可以放开跑。本地人在这里跑步、打球、遛狗，能看到广州的日常生活。

en: Free to enter the outdoor grounds
zh: 就在正佳广场和天河城之间

tips.en: Some areas may be closed during events.
tips.zh: 有赛事或活动时部分区域可能封闭。

query: 野人先生 gelato Tianhe Road, Guangzhou

summary.en: Chinese gelato chain, made fresh in-store each day with many rotating flavours.
summary.zh: 国内连锁意式冰淇淋店，每天店内现做，口味多且常换。

why.en: Gelato is made in-store daily, and local flavours appear next to Italian classics. Tasting is offered before choosing, so kids can try several.
why.zh: 每天店内现做，除了经典意式口味，还有本地特色口味。可以先试吃再选，孩子能多试几种。

zh: 天河路一带有多家分店

tips.en: English brand name and exact branch unverified; search “野人先生” in Amap and pick the nearest Tianhe Road branch.
tips.zh: 英文名和具体分店未核实；在高德搜“野人先生”，选天河路附近的分店。

query: Foshan Ancestral Temple, 21 Zumiao Road, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Taoist temple to the god Beidi, first built in the Northern Song dynasty; home to the lion dance show and kung fu memorial halls.
summary.zh: 供奉北帝的道观，始建于北宋；醒狮表演和武术纪念馆都在里面。

why.en: Its ridges are covered in coloured Shiwan ceramic figures — some of the finest Lingnan decorative art anywhere. The daily lion dance and kung fu show, the Wong Fei-hung and Ip Man halls, and a Qing opera stage are all covered by one ticket, so a full morning is spent without moving the car.
why.zh: 屋脊上满是彩色石湾陶塑，是岭南装饰艺术的精品。每天的醒狮武术表演、黄飞鸿和叶问纪念馆、清代古戏台都在一张门票里，一个上午不用挪车。

en: Ceramic ridge figures and wood and brick carvings on the main hall
Daily lion dance and kung fu shows
Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall and Ip Man Hall inside
Wanfu Stage, a Qing-dynasty opera stage
zh: 大殿的陶塑瓦脊、木雕、砖雕
园内有黄飞鸿纪念馆和叶问堂

tips.en: Open 8:30–18:00. Ask at entry whether same-day re-entry is allowed.
tips.zh: 开放时间8:30至18:00；入园时问清楚当天能否再进。

name.en: Lion Dance and Kung Fu Show, Foshan Ancestral Temple

query: Foshan Ancestral Temple, 21 Zumiao Road, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Daily southern lion dance and kung fu performance inside the temple grounds.
summary.zh: 祖庙内每天上演的南狮和武术表演。

why.en: Foshan is the home of the southern lion dance, and this show is performed in the town where Wong Fei-hung's lineage was rooted. Lions climb poles and leap between stands while drums play; kids are usually spellbound.
why.zh: 佛山是南狮的发源地，也是黄飞鸿武术流派扎根的地方。狮子在鼓声中上桩、跳跃，孩子通常看得目不转睛。

en: Kung fu forms by local troupes

tips.en: Arrive 15 min early for front spots. Suspended in rain; times and venue per the temple notice on the day.
tips.zh: 提前15分钟到占前排；雨天暂停，时间和场地以当天公告为准。

query: Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall, Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Memorial hall to the Foshan-born martial artist and physician Wong Fei-hung, inside the temple grounds.
summary.zh: 纪念佛山武术家、医师黄飞鸿的展馆，在祖庙景区内。

why.en: Wong Fei-hung is the folk hero of dozens of kung fu films, and his real life as a martial artist and doctor is shown here. Kids who have seen the films can match the legend to the man.
why.zh: 黄飞鸿是几十部功夫片的主角，这里展示他作为武师和医生的真实生平。看过电影的孩子可以对照传说和真人。

en: Film stills and kung fu exhibits

query: Ip Man Hall, Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Memorial hall to Foshan-born Wing Chun master Ip Man, teacher of Bruce Lee.
summary.zh: 纪念佛山咏春宗师叶问的展馆，叶问是李小龙的师父。

why.en: Ip Man was born in Foshan and later taught Bruce Lee in Hong Kong. Wooden training dummies (木人桩) are set up for photos, which kids enjoy trying.
why.zh: 叶问生于佛山，后来在香港教出了李小龙。馆内有木人桩可以拍照，孩子喜欢上手试。

en: Ip Man's life and the Wing Chun lineage

query: Wanfu Stage, Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Weekend Cantonese opera on a Qing-dynasty stage inside Foshan Ancestral Temple.
summary.zh: 周末在祖庙清代古戏台万福台上演的粤剧。

why.en: Foshan is regarded as a birthplace of Cantonese opera, and Wanfu Stage, built in the Qing dynasty, is one of the oldest surviving opera stages in Guangdong. Costumes, gilded carvings and live music can be seen up close; half an hour is enough for kids.
why.zh: 佛山被视为粤剧发源地之一，万福台建于清代，是广东现存最古老的戏台之一。戏服、金漆木雕和现场乐队都能近看，孩子看半小时就够。

tips.en: Schedule per the temple notice on the day; re-entry to the temple may need a ticket.
tips.zh: 演出时间以当天公告为准；重新入园可能要门票。

query: Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Landmark tower on the central axis of Lingnan Tiandi, decorated with ceramic sculpture.
summary.zh: 岭南天地中轴线上的地标，墙上有陶瓷雕塑。

why.en: It is the natural starting point and meeting spot in Lingnan Tiandi. Ceramic sculptures and “double happiness” tile patterns on the walls make it a good family photo.
why.zh: 是逛岭南天地的起点和集合点。墙上的陶瓷雕塑和“喜喜”瓦拼花适合拍全家福。

tips.en: Exact name of the tower not verified; navigate to Lingnan Tiandi and ask for 钟楼.
tips.zh: 钟楼正式名称未核实；导航到岭南天地后现场问路。

query: Jian's Villa, Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Early-Republic Western-style villas built by the founders of Nanyang Brothers Tobacco.
summary.zh: 南洋兄弟烟草公司创始人简氏兄弟建的民初西洋式别墅群。

why.en: The Jian brothers made their fortune with Double Happiness cigarettes, and this is Foshan's largest surviving early-Republic villa group. The balconied “Young Ladies' Tower” tells how unmarried daughters once watched the street without being seen.
why.zh: 简氏兄弟靠红双喜香烟起家，这里是佛山现存最大的民初洋楼群。带阳台的“小姐楼”讲的是未出嫁的小姐如何在楼上看街景。

en: Largest early-Republic villa group in Foshan
Mix of Western and Lingnan details
zh: 佛山现存最大的民初洋楼群

query: 龙塘诗社 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Two-storey white building mixing Chinese and Western styles, on the site of a Qing literati garden.
summary.zh: 中西合璧的两层小白楼，前身是清代文人雅集的花园。

why.en: A quiet stop between busier streets, with clean white façades that photograph well. Rotating exhibitions are often held inside.
why.zh: 热闹街区里的安静一站，白色立面拍照好看，楼内常有展览。

tips.en: Exhibitions vary and may not be on.
tips.zh: 展览不固定，可能当天没有。

query: 文会里嫁娶屋 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Traditional house once used for weddings, now showing old Foshan wedding customs.
summary.zh: 旧时办婚礼的大屋，现在展示佛山传统婚嫁习俗。

why.en: Old Cantonese wedding customs are explained through the rooms. Wedding dress and a bridal sedan chair can be tried for photos, which kids tend to love.
why.zh: 通过房间布置讲解旧时广府婚俗。可以穿喜服、坐花轿拍照，孩子通常很喜欢。

en: Wedding dress and sedan chair photos

tips.en: Dress-up may be a paid add-on; check on site.
tips.zh: 换装拍照可能另外收费，以现场为准。

query: 行运楼 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Sit-down Cantonese restaurant inside Lingnan Tiandi.
summary.zh: 岭南天地内可以正式坐下来吃的粤菜馆。

why.en: A proper sit-down meal is offered inside the old quarter, so no car is needed between sights. Cantonese classics suit kids who prefer mild flavours.
why.zh: 就在老街区里，坐下来正式吃一餐，不用再坐车。粤菜口味清淡，适合孩子。

tips.en: Name comes from an older guide; whether it is still open should be checked on the day.
tips.zh: 店名来自较早的攻略，到时确认是否仍在营业。

query: 太艮堡毋米粥 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Shunde-style congee hotpot, cooked in rice broth with the grains strained out.
summary.zh: 顺德毋米粥火锅：米粒熬化后滤掉，只用米汤做锅底。

why.en: Rice is boiled until it dissolves and the grains are strained out, so only a silky rice broth is left as the hotpot base. Seafood and meat are cooked in it briefly, then the thickened broth is eaten as congee at the end — two courses from one pot, and gentle enough for kids.
why.zh: 米熬到化开后把米粒滤掉，只留顺滑米汤做锅底。海鲜、肉类涮熟先吃，最后锅底变成浓粥再喝，一锅两吃，孩子也合口。

tips.en: Name comes from an older guide; whether this branch is still open should be checked on the day.
tips.zh: 店名来自较早的攻略，到时确认是否仍在营业。

query: 李众胜堂祖铺 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Original shop of the century-old pharmacy that created Po Chai pills.
summary.zh: 百年老药铺，保济丸的发源地。

why.en: Po Chai pills (保济丸), still sold across southern China and Hong Kong, were first made here in the late Qing dynasty. The wooden loft and chandeliers of the old shop are preserved.
why.zh: 至今在华南和香港仍常见的保济丸，清末就在这里诞生。老铺的木阁楼和吊灯都保留着。

query: 李禧记 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Old Foshan biscuit maker, with the Foshan Gong (佛山公) souvenir shop nearby.
summary.zh: 佛山老字号饼家，附近还有佛山公手信店。

why.en: Foshan's classic snacks are bought here in one stop: bengsha (崩砂) crisp biscuits, blind man's cakes (盲公饼) and maltose candy. They travel well and make easy gifts.
why.zh: 佛山经典手信一站买齐：崩砂、盲公饼、麦芽糖。耐放好带，适合送人。

tips.en: Exact shop positions inside Lingnan Tiandi unverified.
tips.zh: 两家店在岭南天地的具体位置未核实。

query: 中国调味文化馆 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Small museum on the history of Foshan soy sauce and condiments.
summary.zh: 讲佛山酱油和调味品历史的小型展馆。

why.en: Haday, China's best-known soy sauce brand, comes from Foshan, and the traditional sun-brewing process is shown here. A quick loop gives kids a link between the food they eat and where it comes from.
why.zh: 中国最知名的酱油品牌海天就出自佛山，这里展示传统晒制酱油的工艺。快快看一圈，孩子能把吃到的东西和来源联系起来。

tips.en: Opening hours and exact location unverified.
tips.zh: 开放时间和具体位置未核实。

query: 石湾酒庄 酒行会馆 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Former wine merchants' guild hall showcasing Shiwan Yubingshao rice wine.
summary.zh: 旧时酒商议事的会馆，展示石湾玉冰烧米酒。

why.en: Shiwan Yubingshao, a rice spirit aged with pork fat, is a Foshan speciality with roots in the Qing dynasty. The restored guild hall shows how the merchants met and traded; ten minutes is enough.
why.zh: 石湾玉冰烧是以肥猪肉浸泡陈酿的米酒，是佛山特产，源自清代。修复后的会馆展示旧时酒商聚会交易的场景，看十分钟就够。

query: Qinghui Garden, 23 Qinghui Road, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: One of the Four Great Gardens of Lingnan, a Ming-Qing private garden in central Daliang.
summary.zh: 岭南四大名园之一，大良城中的明清私家园林。

why.en: Lingnan garden design is seen at its most compact here: bridges, ponds, bamboo and carved windows fitted into a small town plot. Paths and small bridges keep kids exploring, and a full loop takes only about 50 minutes.
why.zh: 岭南园林在小块地上把小桥、水池、竹林和花窗安排得很紧凑。小路和小桥让孩子一路探索，走一圈约50分钟。

en: One of the Four Great Gardens of Lingnan

tips.en: Closes in the early evening; check the last-entry time at the gate.
tips.zh: 傍晚关门，到门口先看入园截止时间。

query: Huagai Road Pedestrian Street, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: Daliang's oldest arcade (qilou) street, lined with old brands, snacks and souvenir shops.
summary.zh: 大良最老的骑楼街，两边是老字号、小吃和手信店。

why.en: Shunde is a UNESCO City of Gastronomy, and its street snacks are sampled here in a short walk. Lunjiao cake, Daliang fried milk and beef offal skewers can be eaten on the go under the arcades.
why.zh: 顺德是联合国教科文组织认定的“美食之都”，这条短街就能尝到街头小吃。伦教糕、大良炒牛奶、牛杂串都可以在骑楼下边走边吃。

query: 香云纱园林酒店, 25 Qinghui Road, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: Long-standing Daliang restaurant next to Qinghui Garden, serving classic Shunde dishes.
summary.zh: 清晖园旁的凤城老字号，做经典顺德菜。

why.en: Classic Shunde home-style dishes are served right beside Qinghui Garden. Fried milk (炒牛奶) — milk and egg white stir-fried into soft curds — was invented in Daliang and is a natural pick for kids.
why.zh: 就在清晖园旁边吃经典顺德菜。炒牛奶是大良发明的菜，牛奶和蛋白炒成嫩滑的块，孩子容易接受。

name.en: Daliang Rongbian Spare Rib Rice, Branch 3

query: 容边排骨饭 三店, Guangfeng Building, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: Local spare-rib rice institution beside Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road.
summary.zh: 清晖园和华盖路旁的本地排骨饭名店。

why.en: Spare ribs are steamed directly on the rice in individual bowls, so the juices soak into the grains — a plain dish done exactly right. Sizzling clay pots and meatball soup round it out, and double-skin milk (双皮奶), which originated in Daliang, finishes the meal.
why.zh: 排骨直接铺在米饭上一碗一碗蒸，肉汁渗进饭里，简单但做得到位。再配啫啫煲、肉丸汤，最后来一碗大良发源的双皮奶。

en: Steamed spare rib rice (干蒸排骨饭)

tips.en: 2/F Guangfeng Building (广丰大厦二楼). Arrive at 17:30 to avoid queues. Tel 13450801998.
tips.zh: 广丰大厦二楼；17:30开门就到，不用排队。电话13450801998。

aliases: 白马服装市场、红棉国际时装城
query: Baima Clothing Market, 16 Zhanqian Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Large wholesale clothing market next to Guangzhou Railway Station, with Hongmian International Fashion City beside it.
summary.zh: 广州火车站旁的大型服装批发市场，红棉国际时装城就在旁边。

why.en: Guangzhou is a hub of China's garment trade, and wholesale prices are seen first-hand here. Baima leans mid-to-upper-range women's workwear; next-door Hongmian leans trendy. Many stalls sell single pieces and bargaining is expected.
why.zh: 广州是全国服装贸易中心，这里能直接看到批发价。白马偏中高档通勤女装，旁边的红棉偏潮流款。很多档口一件起卖，可以讲价。

en: Hongmian International Fashion City next door
Single pieces sold at many stalls
zh: 红棉国际时装城就在隔壁

tips.en: Busy on Sunday mornings; backpacks worn on the front. Some stalls are wholesale-only.
tips.zh: 周日上午人多，背包背在前面；部分档口只批发。

query: Tianzi Pier, Yanjiang Middle Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Evening boat cruise along the Pearl River past the lit-up Canton Tower and city skyline.
summary.zh: 夜晚沿珠江坐船，看灯光下的广州塔和两岸夜景。

why.en: Guangzhou's skyline is seen at its best from the water: Canton Tower, Haizhu Bridge and the Bund-style buildings along Yanjiang Road are all lit up. Kids get a boat ride without much walking at the end of the day.
why.zh: 从江上看广州夜景最好：广州塔、海珠桥、沿江路的老建筑都亮灯。一天下来不用多走路，孩子还能坐船。

tips.en: Tickets and pier should be confirmed in advance; be at the pier 20 min early and bring a jacket.
tips.zh: 船票和码头提前确定；开船前20分钟到，带外套。

query: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, Baiyun, Guangzhou

summary.en: Guangzhou's main airport, ~45 min by taxi from Tianhe in early-morning traffic.
summary.zh: 广州主要机场，清晨从天河打车约45分钟。

why.en: International check-in, bag drop and security can take a while, so ~2 h 45 min is allowed. Breakfast is available airside.
why.zh: 国际航班值机、托运、安检耗时，所以预留约2小时45分钟；可以在机场吃早餐。

tips.en: Terminal depends on the airline; confirm T1, T2 or T3 on the ticket before booking the car.
tips.zh: 航站楼按航空公司而定，叫车前在机票上确认是T1、T2还是T3。
